hero.headline: I turn complex business problems
hero.description: I work with founders, growing businesses and professional organizations to design better systems, products, processes and experiences — and help turn them into reality.

intro.label: Connecting the dots
intro.title: I work where business problems need practical solutions.
paragraphs: I combine business strategy, operations, project management, product thinking and UX to help organizations solve complex challenges.
My strength is quickly understanding how a business works, identifying friction or opportunities, and translating them into systems, products, processes or projects that can actually be implemented.
intro.quote: I understand problems, connect the dots and turn ideas into practical solutions.
